$comment: Shared VfNavMenu cases, rendered by the Vue adapter at the reference commit, by the current Vue adapter, and by the real Razor adapter with its browser controller. A recursive tree whose controls are native: a button per branch, a button or an anchor per leaf. Every link is a hash link, so a click navigates without leaving the page; target=_blank links are never clicked. Every instance sits in a measurement box, `box` pixels wide or filling the case; the snapshot narrows, widens and restores the box of every sidebar to drive its ResizeObserver. A controlled case is a v-model consumer in Vue; the Razor adapter reads model-value as the initial value (platform divergence razor-has-no-controlled-mode). No case uses `to`: the router handoff is Vue-only and characterised there; the Razor adapter refuses it by name.

propVocabulary.items: The tree, { value, label, kind?, leadingIcon?, href?, target?, rel?, disabled?, children? }. Never `to`. Static on every target.
propVocabulary.modelValue: string. The model; the Vue fixture writes update:modelValue back, the Razor adapter reads it as the initial value.
propVocabulary.compact: boolean. Explicit compactness of a sidebar.

contentVocabulary.box: The width in pixels of the box the instance is rendered in. Absent, the box fills the case.
contentVocabulary.boxes: The same per member of a group.

groupVocabulary: A list of sibling nav menus rendered side by side in one case, each with its own props and its own box; the case-level props are ignored, the attrs apply to each.

ownershipVocabulary.componentInteractive: The exact number of controls the component renders: one per visible branch, button leaf and link leaf, disabled ones included. Groups, lists and collapse wrappers are structure.
ownershipVocabulary.consumerInteractive: The exact number of consumer focusable elements in the case: none.
ownershipVocabulary.consumerInteractiveRoles: The exact number of elements carrying an explicit interactive role: none - the reference writes no role.

interactionVocabulary.$comment: A case with an `interaction` is driven with real pointer and key events, alone on the page, then re-measured: snapshot, DOM and accessibility tree. The snapshot waits, bounded, for every collapse to settle.
interactionVocabulary.steps: clickButton on `.vf-nav-menu__item` with the `index` of the visible item, focusButton likewise, pressKey with Enter, Space, Tab or ArrowDown. Every fixture swallows the browser default of a navigation key the product left unhandled - after recording that it did.
interactionVocabulary.expect: Claims about the snapshot fields of the same name: expandedLabels, currentLabels, events, locationHash, settled, focusItem and keydownPrevented.
interactionVocabulary.matches: The static case of the same content whose fresh render the gesture has to land on.

cases.title: A collapsed tree: three top-level items, branch buttons closed, nothing current
cases.$why: The closed half of the topology: branch buttons with aria-expanded=false, no collapse anywhere, a native anchor nowhere because every link is inside a closed branch.

cases.title: The landmark named by ariaLabel
cases.$why: The nav's accessible name is the prop; the tree reads it.

cases.title: An empty ariaLabel is written empty, not replaced by the default
cases.$why: The reference binds the prop as given.

cases.title: A top-level button leaf current: aria-current=page, nothing expanded
cases.$why: Activation of a top-level value has no ancestry to open.

cases.title: A nested button leaf current: its two ancestors expanded and marked ancestor-active
cases.$why: The ancestry opens at render and both ancestors carry the li and button modifiers; the current button is the only aria-current.

cases.title: A nested link current: aria-current on the anchor, its parent expanded
cases.$why: A link leaf announces the current page as a button leaf does.

cases.title: The deepest link of the tree current
cases.$why: Two levels of ancestry, the innermost a link.

cases.title: A branch value current: its li alone is marked, it stays closed, no aria-current
cases.$why: A branch is never current by aria-current and activation does not open it - only its ancestors.

cases.title: A value no item has: nothing current, nothing open
cases.$why: An unknown value is kept without effect.

cases.title: Three items share the active value: the first match's ancestry opens, every rendered match is current
cases.$why: The ancestry is the first match in document order; the active mark is per item.

cases.title: A controlled value renders as an uncontrolled default of the same value
cases.$why: The Vue fixture writes update:modelValue back; the Razor adapter reads model-value as the initial value (platform divergence razor-has-no-controlled-mode).

cases.title: modelValue wins over defaultValue
cases.$why: Both props given: the model is the active value.

cases.title: A group: a div over an always-rendered nested list; branches inside it closed
cases.$why: Groups make the menu not simple and carry no control.

cases.title: A value inside a group: the group's li is expanded and ancestor-active, the group div stays bare
cases.$why: Group values are part of the ancestry.

cases.title: A group's own value current: its li is --active, nothing is aria-current
cases.$why: A group is never a control.

cases.title: Four levels: level classes, level declarations and collapse levels down the path
cases.$why: The recursion, the level on every element and the collapse level of each branch.

cases.title: Leading icons on a branch, a nested item, a link and an unknown name; a group's icon is not rendered
cases.$why: The glyph slot, the icon-offset rule and the moon fallback for a name no glyph has.

cases.title: Native anchors: _self, an explicit rel, _blank with the derived rel and the external glyph, _blank with an explicit rel, an empty href, and a target without a destination
cases.$why: The link contract: rel is VfLink's rule, the external glyph follows _blank, href is a link by definedness, and a target without a destination renders a button with nothing of it.

cases.title: A disabled link keeps its href with aria-disabled and tabindex=-1; a disabled button and a disabled branch are natively disabled
cases.$why: The disabled contract, per element kind.

cases.title: A disabled link that is current: aria-current beside aria-disabled
cases.$why: The reference never refuses a disabled current item.

cases.title: A disabled branch on the active path is expanded
cases.$why: Activation ignores disabled.

cases.title: Empty children make a leaf; a branch with a destination is a button and drops it; an empty group; an escaped label
cases.$why: The branch and link tests at their edges.

cases.title: No items: the nav, the probe and an empty list
cases.$why: The skeleton of the component. No height, so no screenshot.

cases.title: The pills variant
cases.$why: The variant modifier.

cases.title: A sidebar wider than the probe: not compact
cases.$why: Measured after mount; the probe narrows and widens its box.

cases.title: A sidebar narrower than the probe: compact after measurement
cases.$why: The reference measures on mount; the server never does, so this is the enhanced state.

cases.title: A sidebar exactly as wide as the probe: compact
cases.$why: rootWidth <= breakpointWidth.

cases.title: An explicit compact on a wide sidebar
cases.$why: The prop wins over the measurement.

cases.title: An explicit compact=false on a narrow sidebar
cases.$why: The prop wins over the measurement, both ways.

cases.title: compact on a pills menu is ignored
cases.$why: Only the sidebar is ever compact.

cases.title: A non-simple sidebar with icons and groups, narrow
cases.$why: The compact sidebar with icon-aligned items.

cases.title: Two sidebars side by side, one narrow and one wide: each measures its own box
cases.$why: Instance isolation: the probe narrows one box at a time and reads both.

cases.title: Single mode renders like multiple until a toggle
cases.$why: Single mode is enforced on opening only.

cases.title: Consumer attributes on the nav: id, class, data-testid, title, style
cases.$why: Every attr falls through to the nav, after the component classes.

cases.title: A branch click opens it: aria-expanded, the li and the chevron flip, the collapse enters
cases.$why: The enter, frame by frame, and nothing announced.

cases.title: Opening and closing a branch lands on the collapsed tree
cases.$why: The leave and its removal.

cases.title: Closing the open ancestry of the current item keeps it marked ancestor-active
cases.$why: Closing removes one expanded value; the active marks are the value's.

cases.title: Opening a nested branch inside an open one
cases.$why: A second level enters while the first stays.

cases.title: Closing a parent hides an open child
cases.$why: The child's expansion is kept, its subtree goes with the parent's.

cases.title: Reopening the parent shows the child still open, rendered without a transition
cases.$why: Nested expansion survives the parent's close; only the toggled branch animates.

cases.title: Multiple mode keeps siblings open
cases.$why: Two top-level branches open together.

cases.title: Single mode: opening a sibling closes the other
cases.$why: The sibling rule at the top level.

cases.title: Single mode: opening a sibling inside a group closes the other and the branch below it
cases.$why: Sibling branches and every branch below them close.

cases.title: Single mode: reopening a sibling shows the branch below it closed
cases.$why: The sibling rule removed the descendant's value too, so it does not come back with its parent.

cases.title: Single mode: a sibling group is skipped whole
cases.$why: Opening Layout leaves Input, inside the Forms group, open.

cases.title: Single mode: reopening a parent keeps its own open child
cases.$why: The opened branch's own descendants are not siblings.

cases.title: Single mode: closing a branch touches nothing else
cases.$why: Closing never applies the sibling rule.

cases.title: A button leaf click makes it current and announces it once
cases.$why: update:modelValue, change and select in Vue; one vf-nav-menu:change in Razor; the neutral log has one entry.

cases.title: Clicking the current item announces it again
cases.$why: The reference emits on every enabled leaf click.

cases.title: Selecting a nested button moves the current item and the ancestor marks
cases.$why: The active value is the root's; every node repaints.

cases.title: A link click selects and navigates: the hash is the link's
cases.$why: A native anchor's navigation is not prevented.

cases.title: Selecting a second item moves aria-current off the first
cases.$why: One current item at a time for distinct values.

cases.title: A disabled link click is prevented: no announcement, no navigation
cases.$why: onLeafClick prevents and returns.

cases.title: A controlled menu written back moves like an uncontrolled one
cases.$why: The v-model consumer and the Razor initial value land on the same tree (razor-has-no-controlled-mode).

cases.title: Closing the branch above a group with the current item inside
cases.$why: The group li keeps its expanded value while hidden.

cases.title: Enter on a focused branch is native activation: it toggles once and keeps focus
cases.$why: No keydown handler; the native click does it.

cases.title: Space on a focused leaf button selects it natively
cases.$why: Space activates on keyup.

cases.title: ArrowDown on a branch does nothing and is not prevented
cases.$why: The reference has no arrow-key navigation.

cases.title: Tab from the first item skips the disabled link and the disabled buttons
cases.$why: tabindex=-1 and the native disabled leave the tab order.

cases.title: A branch opens in a compact sidebar
cases.$why: The compact sidebar is still a tree.

cases.title: Opening four levels one by one
cases.$why: The recursion under the toggle.
